title: 2-million-year-old DNA from Greenland sediments
summary: Environmental DNA from sediments in northern Greenland, at least two million years old, revealed a lost forest ecosystem with mastodons.
why: Shows how far back DNA can reach, far beyond human history.

notes.problem: 'Oldest DNA ever' not in source, which says the DNA is 'at least two million years old'; 'ever' is an absolute claim.
